title: English Practice Quiz 0895
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A maintenance log records ___.
options: reported faults, inspections and repair actions
questions.explanation: reported faults, inspections and repair actions is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Preventive maintenance is performed to ___.
options: reduce the likelihood of equipment failure
questions.explanation: reduce the likelihood of equipment failure is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A reported equipment fault should include ___.
questions.explanation: equipment identity, symptoms and location is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A maintenance work order describes ___.
questions.explanation: a specific maintenance task is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: If a damaged electrical cable is found, staff should ___.
options: keep people away and report it through the safety process
questions.explanation: keep people away and report it through the safety process is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: An asset register tracks ___.
questions.explanation: equipment and other organisational assets is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A planned maintenance window is ___.
options: a scheduled period for inspection or repair
questions.explanation: a scheduled period for inspection or repair is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Recording a completed repair helps ___.
options: maintain history and confirm the work was done
questions.explanation: maintain history and confirm the work was done is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A recurring equipment fault should prompt ___.
questions.explanation: investigation into its underlying cause is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Before returning repaired equipment to service, confirm ___.
options: it has been checked and released under procedure
questions.explanation: it has been checked and released under procedure is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.
